sloka: तस्मान्मुहूर्तं काङ्क्षिष्ये विक्रमं पार्थिवस्य तु।भिन्नं च वानरानीकं तावदाश्वासयाम्यहम् ।। ६.६७.८१ ।।
transliteration: tasmānmuhūrtaṁ kāṅkṣiṣye vikramaṁ pārthivasya tu।bhinnaṁ ca vānarānīkaṁ tāvadāśvāsayāmyaham ।। 6.67.81 ।।

translations.english: "If Sugriva is released by me, he will not be happy forever. His fame will be lost."
